scope: C327 art-derived UI colors for all 100 existing busts

G24.name: 장료

provenance.method: Opaque pixels (alpha>240), RGB buckets of 16 with midpoint; primary saturation>.20 and value .20-.70; G24 red>1.7*green; auxiliary value>.55. Modal bucket in each ROI. Coordinates refer to 384x384 original.
provenance.documentSearch: INTERPRETATION / VISUAL_HANDOFF / design files under officer-production searched for palette, colors and hex. No settled personal palette found. G18 interpretation line 667 explicitly does not bind faction colors to personal costume.

factionComparison.reason: Keep measured darker costume shade, distinct from bright faction badge. Color applies only to ability interiors; faction emblems and borders stay separate.

G24.status: art-derived-ui-sample; does not change officer or faction approval
